moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio lk-vignette, written here): Radial gradient overlay, clear in the middle, edges darkening; edge darkness 15 % <-> 25 % on a 3000 ms sine loop (opacity yoyo). Demo: clear inside r 60, full at r 200 on a 320 x 200 frame, edge alpha 0.25-0.45. House lesson: no grade + vignette over footage by default. Params: amount (15 ↔ 25 %) · period (3 s). House rule: no grade and vignette over footage by default.
